    Illinois vs. Iowa men's basketball game on January 11 was aired on FOX. The game, hosted at Iowa's Carver-Hawkeye Arena, was also available to stream on FuboTV and via the FOX Sports website. 
    Details of the Jan 11 Meeting: 
    • Channel: FOX
    • Time: 11 a.m. CT
    • Location: Carver-Hawkeye Arena (Iowa City)
    • Stream Options: Fubo (free trial) and FoxSports.com 
    Note: For the 2026 Big Ten Women's Tournament meeting (March 6), the game was on the Big Ten Network (BTN)
